_comment: Demo material asset -- texture-supporting sibling of m_demo_vertex_lit.material.json, targets the "ForwardVertexLitTextured" shader (ShaderPropertySchema.h): the same per-vertex lighting formula, but "albedoTexture" references assets/m7_checker.png's own committed Asset GUID (see assets/m7_checker.png.meta, the same checker texture m_demo_checker_tint.material.json already uses for the *unlit* ForwardLitTexturedColor case) instead of falling back to tintColor alone, with a warm tint on top. Referenced by editor/assets/demo.scene.json's RotateScript cube (its mesh is assets/m7_quad.gltf here instead of the shared m1_cube.glb, same reason m_demo_checker_tint.material.json's own comment gives: m1_cube.glb predates TEXCOORD_0) -- spinning proves the per-vertex lit color updates correctly as the entity's own normals rotate through the scene's lights, not just that a texture samples correctly while static.
